### DHI Group to Present at the Planet MicroCap Las Vegas Investor Conference on June 17-18, 2026


June 10, 2026


CENTENNIAL, Colo.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


DHI Group, Inc. (NYSE: DHX) announced today that Art Zeile, Chief Executive Officer, and Greg Schippers, Chief Financial Officer, will present at the Planet MicroCap Las Vegas 2026 Investor Conference Powered by MicroCapClub on Wednesday, June 17, 2026, at 10:00 AM PT. Scheduled 1x1 meetings are also available for registered investor attendees.


To access the live presentation at the scheduled time, please use the following link:


[https://event.summitcast.com/view/bpjo3VVjZ25pp6SXpUua92/AeJWWHGYtRevQbzoEaefVD](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fevent.summitcast.com%2Fview%2Fbpjo3VVjZ25pp6SXpUua92%2FAeJWWHGYtRevQbzoEaefVD&esheet=54551042&newsitemid=20260610479655&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fevent.summitcast.com%2Fview%2Fbpjo3VVjZ25pp6SXpUua92%2FAeJWWHGYtRevQbzoEaefVD&index=1&md5=c29daf5fdd0ea2017e8739bd899b3167)


If you would like to schedule a 1x1 meeting with management and attend Planet MicroCap Las Vegas 2026, please make sure you are registered here:[REGISTER](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.meetmax.com%2Fsched%2Fevent_130817%2Fconference_register.html&esheet=54551042&newsitemid=20260610479655&lan=en-US&anchor=REGISTER&index=2&md5=8491a0d79954da28fab4ae90e8ccff18)


1x1 meetings will be held in person at the conference venue: Bellagio Resort & Hotel in Las Vegas, NV.


The Planet MicroCap Las Vegas 2026 website is available at:[HOME PAGE](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.meetmax.com%2Fsched%2Fevent_130817%2Fconference_home.html&esheet=54551042&newsitemid=20260610479655&lan=en-US&anchor=HOME+PAGE&index=3&md5=7144b1ebac58d5f05ee9878b75d9fc1d)


A video webcast of the presentation will be available on the Company's website at[https://dhigroupinc.com/investors/default.aspx after the event](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fdhigroupinc.com%2Finvestors%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54551042&newsitemid=20260610479655&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fdhigroupinc.com%2Finvestors%2Fdefault.aspx+after+the+event&index=4&md5=ae9f411618f7bd0657376d0185e9d425) , and as part of a complete catalog of presentations on the conference event platform at this link under the “Agenda” tab:[AGENDA](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.meetmax.com%2Fsched%2Fevent_130817%2Fconference_presentations.html%3Fbank_access%3D0%26event_id%3D130817&esheet=54551042&newsitemid=20260610479655&lan=en-US&anchor=AGENDA&index=5&md5=5ec1801b878bc2ca4ea6a842800c35b5)


**About DHI Group, Inc.**


DHI Group, Inc. (NYSE: DHX) is a provider of AI-powered career marketplaces that focus on technology roles. DHI’s two brands, ClearanceJobs and Dice, enable recruiters and hiring managers to efficiently search for and connect with highly skilled technology professionals based on the skills requested. The Company’s patented algorithm manages over 100,000 unique technology skills. Additionally, our marketplaces allow tech professionals to find their ideal next career opportunity, with relevant advice and personalized insights. Learn more at[www.dhigroupinc.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.dhigroupinc.com&esheet=54551042&newsitemid=20260610479655&lan=en-US&anchor=www.dhigroupinc.com&index=6&md5=e97fb68424fc14ee5abafc12a82fca04) .


**About Planet MicroCap**


Planet Microcap hosts the highest quality microcap in-person events in North America. The mission is to bring the best microcap investors, companies, and allocators together to gather, connect, and grow. For more information about Planet MicroCap, please visit:[https://planetmicrocap.com/](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fplanetmicrocap.com%2F&esheet=54551042&newsitemid=20260610479655&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fplanetmicrocap.com%2F&index=7&md5=a6d63a189f3c8d9d20ab4fdd95b5d745)


**About MicroCapClub**


MicroCapClub is an exclusive forum for experienced microcap investors to share and discuss microcap companies (sub $1 billion market cap) trading on global markets. Since 2011, our members have profiled 1500+ microcap companies, 300+ have turned into multi-baggers. Investors can join our community by applying to become a member or subscribing to gain instant access. For more information, visit[https://microcapclub.com/](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fmicrocapclub.com%2F&esheet=54551042&newsitemid=20260610479655&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fmicrocapclub.com%2F&index=8&md5=2e49b78fa38ef2deb6e792be8b4939a3) .
